name: Crewed Mars transfer (nominal)
notes: Power level from the NASEM planning assumption of roughly 2 MWe for a human-rated Mars mission in the 2039 timeframe. Payload mass and delta-v are stated assumptions for this project, not values taken from the source

name: Crewed Mars transfer (fast)
notes: Upper end of the NASEM 2 to 6 MWe range for an opposition-class mission. Higher delta-v reflects a faster low-thrust transfer. Payload mass, delta-v and trip-time cap are stated assumptions

name: 500 kg deep-space probe (nominal)
notes: Payload, delta-v, trip-time cap and available power are stated assumptions for this project. Power level is representative of a large solar-electric outer-planets-bound bus near 1 AU

name: 500 kg deep-space probe (high energy)
notes: High-energy variant used to show how the ranking moves with delta-v. All parameters are stated assumptions
